parameters.actualScope: Pigment guidance, not fixed pixels; not every supplied swatch is used verbatim.

rules.principle: Coordinate terrain and vegetation pigments before adding detail.

referenceEvidence.observation: Connected golden grass masses share base/shadow colors across ground and growth.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Use the same world-space pigment/painted texture fields for terrain and real blades.
rules.result: Warmer coherent substrate supports sparse geometry; material wiring bug in first edge batch was fixed.
rules.knownLimitations: Current midground still has separated marks; not proof of a complete swath solution.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Shared pigment relationships; exact gold palette is biome-specific.
constraints.otherBiomes: Untested; do not apply numerical profiles automatically

referenceEvidence.observation: Near gold gives way to quieter straw and blue-sage near the horizon.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Overlapping smooth world-distance pigment ramps; preserve existing sky/exposure.
rules.result: Ground/grass fades smoothly across tested views/seeds without discrete color bands.
rules.knownLimitations: Other trees retain existing distance response; atmosphere is not physical volumetric scattering.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Distance hierarchy generalizes; transition scales/pigments need local calibration.
constraints.otherBiomes: Untested; do not apply numerical profiles automatically

rules.principle: Terrain silhouette must express biome identity.

referenceEvidence.observation: The reference is predominantly an open plain with occasional shallow landforms and distant geology.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Halve added continuation relief, retain low inner terrain and distant illustrated geology.
rules.result: Inspection reads as broader plains while terrain continuity remains.
rules.knownLimitations: Reduction applies to added apron relief, not every original ground amplitude; drainage is preserved visually, not hydrologically simulated.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Match landform scale to biome; do not use this flatness for all environments.
constraints.otherBiomes: Untested; do not apply numerical profiles automatically

rules.principle: Fine detail should be localized while medium forms remain connected.

referenceEvidence.observation: Fine foreground blades support larger grass swaths, rather than becoming equally strong marks everywhere.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Near cupped blades and sparse seed heads; cheap mid blades with reduced height at distance; far material dominance.
rules.result: Cost decreases and near parallax is present, but connected midground swaths remain incomplete.
rules.knownLimitations: Do not promote cheaper geometry or sparse coverage into artistic success.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Frequency hierarchy universal; grass geometry/sparsity specific to this study.
constraints.otherBiomes: Untested; do not apply numerical profiles automatically

rules.principle: Surface light must preserve rich shade without a global color filter.

referenceEvidence.observation: Selective warm highlights coexist with cooler readable interiors/valleys.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Keep physical sun and cast shadows; use shared localized world pigment/light response, no grass shadow casting.
rules.result: No rectangular card shadows; ground remains continuous under real blade edges.
rules.knownLimitations: Some mid blades remain dark accents; not a validated physically based grass BRDF.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Lighting coherence generalizes; opacity/normal response must match representation.
constraints.otherBiomes: Untested; do not apply numerical profiles automatically

rules.principle: World-space local value regions should frame a luminous middle without following the screen.

referenceEvidence.observation: Warm dark foreground masses frame luminous golden plains; individual blades support broad values rather than dominate them.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Irregular world-Z progression, coherent sweep field, shared ground/grass pigments, retained distance atmosphere.
rules.result: Warmer shaded foreground and lighter middle are stable in hero and rotated elevated views across3seeds.
rules.knownLimitations: Improvement is modest at seed29; broad foreground remains underdressed. The world-axis field is composed for this anchored encounter, not a universal geography rule.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Test relationships, not copied numeric defaults.
constraints.otherBiomes: Not tested; preserve Puget and rainforest defaults

rules.principle: Dimensional geometry alone does not create soft painterly vegetation masses.

referenceEvidence.observation: Warm dark foreground masses frame luminous golden plains; individual blades support broad values rather than dominate them.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Closed triangular blade cross sections, curved centerlines, sparse seed heads, instancing and shared pigment.
rules.result: Two-segment version looked like gold chips. Four segments reduced angular chips but close views still show stiff folded ribbons; 208226 scene triangles versus107962 baseline is not justified.
rules.knownLimitations: Reject this implementation, not the general idea of geometry-based grass. Next prototype needs smooth curved normals, varied growth trajectories and connected clump silhouettes before population scaling.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Test relationships, not copied numeric defaults.
constraints.otherBiomes: Not tested; preserve Puget and rainforest defaults

rules.principle: Match ground and vegetation at contact while separating the texture projection suitable for each surface.

referenceEvidence.observation: User identifies vertical bands and root-to-ground mismatch, and requests a shorter brush layer with sparse tall accents.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Share world-space pigments and root texture values; fade terrain texture detail and atlas tint by actual height above planted root, using atlas strokes above that zone.
rules.result: Diagnostic removal of projected map detail largely removes bands; flattening normals does not. World-height root blending and shorter grass substantially reduce visible streak walls.
rules.knownLimitations: Only this savanna shader/seed29 tested; low alpha boundaries and sloped ground contact remain imperfect. Root height is relative to the planted anchor, not full per-fragment terrain conformance.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Projection and contact coherence apply widely;6-30cm ranges and golden pigments are experiment-specific.
constraints.otherBiomes: Not modified or tested by this experiment.

rules.principle: Separate landscape structure from coordinated color/lighting state.

referenceEvidence.observation: References combine warm meadows with cool distance in several lighting moods.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Shared world-space pigment fields, palette-driven light/air/rock/vegetation and stable geometry.
rules.result: Three palettes preserve recorded vertex-position/instance-matrix digests in all3 composition families; screenshots show coordinated state changes.
rules.knownLimitations: Structural invariance is verified; this does not establish beauty. Alpine geometry, framing and material richness remain below the references. No physical mobile approval.

constraints.otherBiomes: Existing protected renders remained pixel-identical; do not apply alpine palette values globally.

rules.principle: Distinct upright, low-open and airy flower forms give banks variety without uniform flower scatter.

referenceEvidence.observation: Pink/purple spires and pale rounded flower banks frame a quiet opening.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Three instanced geometry forms, patch-level selection and varied height preserve large-scale value masses.
rules.result: Stronger assortment and near framing at hero scale; close-up petals remain too angular.
rules.knownLimitations: Functional forms, not verified alpine species occurrences; flower geometry not final quality.

constraints.universalPrinciple: Assortment roles may transfer; taxa/palettes must remain biome-specific.

rules.principle: Share projected ground detail at plant bases, then fade it with physical height so texture does not become vertical streaks.

referenceEvidence.source: Retained savanna hybrid root treatment and supplied alpine concept
referenceEvidence.observation: Vegetation emerges from a continuous ground pigment field while upper tufts have their own brushed silhouette/detail.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Fade world-space fine texture over6–30cm while keeping slow-changing pigments coherent.
rules.result: Vertical streaks reduced; normal transfer alone was insufficient.
rules.knownLimitations: Whole candidate still rejected for performance; these numerical fade heights are not universal defaults.

constraints.reuse: Root/detail separation principle transferable; representation budgets must be remeasured.

rules.principle: Transfer vegetation visual coverage and hierarchy across biomes, not raw instance counts.

referenceEvidence.observation: A visually improved field with fewer triangles runs much slower due to added brush-layer cost.

rules.implementationHypothesis: Calibrate card footprint/overlap and distance representation to meadow area; geometry counts alone cannot forecast alpha cost.
rules.result: Current overlapping-card implementation rejected for technical promotion. A lower-overdraw representation remains untested.
rules.knownLimitations: Software renderer evidence, not mobile GPU certification; no winning cheaper representation yet.

constraints.reuse: Measure alpha surface cost separately in all biomes.
